description: Checks the map: missing tileset, image and file-property files, GIDs outside the tilesets, duplicate layer and object ids, nextlayerid/nextobjectid that are too small, object properties pointing nowhere. Every finding has its own code and its own message. The answer always names both: which classes were checked and which are NOT checked in v1. If the map cannot be loaded at all, that is stated as a finding and all content checks are n/a.

path.description: Path to ONE Tiled map file (.tmx or .tmj) — no directory, no wildcards. Please pass it absolute: a relative path is resolved against the working directory of the server process, and that is chosen by the MCP host, not by the project.

name: validate_map
title: Validate a map
